entities.name: Narset
entities.description: A restless, brilliant woman of the dragon-ruled Tarkir who becomes Ojutai's youngest master, learns the truth about his past in the archives, ignites her planeswalker spark, and finally walks away.

entities.name: Ojutai
entities.description: The sleek dragon teacher of Dragon's Eye Sanctuary who names Narset a master; she learns he attacked the khans' summit.

entities.name: Taigam
entities.description: A rival student of Ojutai at Dragon's Eye Sanctuary who seeks power and reports Narset for blasphemy.

entities.name: Ishai
entities.description: A tall, regal aven who is Ojutai's dragonspeaker and invites Narset to Dragon's Eye Sanctuary.

entities.name: Zurgo Helmsmasher
entities.description: The Mardu khan of another timeline who killed Narset; in the present he is a bell-striker.

entities.name: Sarkhan
entities.description: A man, a dragon, a khan named in the scroll who saved the Spirit Dragon and thereby saved Tarkir's dragons.

entities.name: Ugin
entities.description: The Spirit Dragon who is the source of all magic and the dragon tempests, learned of from the scrolls.

entities.name: Dragon's Eye Sanctuary
entities.description: The grandest Jeskai-style sanctuary, where Ojutai teaches from his perch and archives lie beneath it.

entities.name: Archive beneath Dirgur
entities.description: A looted underground archive where Narset finds the last scroll recording the khans' summit.

entities.name: Cori Mountain
entities.description: A place with an archive Narset searched.

entities.name: Riverwheel
entities.description: A place with an archive Narset searched.

entities.name: Eternities
entities.description: The space between worlds on whose edge Narset stands, tempted to planeswalk.

entities.name: Skywise
entities.description: Followers who soar around Narset in celebration when she is named master.

entities.name: Jeskai
entities.description: The clan Narset led as khan in another time; in this time it no longer exists.

entities.name: Mardu
entities.description: The clan of Zurgo, who killed Narset in the lost timeline.

entities.name: Tarkir
entities.description: The plane of dragons where no khans exist.

events.summary: Eight-year-old Narset, restless in a crowded marketplace, accidentally topples a stack of apples and is told to wait outside.
events.quote: She lifted her arm, holding the apple on display—as hundreds more rained down around her

events.summary: Free outside, Narset runs along the river and hears Ojutai's lesson across the distance, and asks to be his student; he nods.
events.quote: I want to be your student," she said. "Please, let me be your student."

events.summary: For three years Narset trains under Ojutai from afar by the riverbank.
events.quote: Over the next three years, Narset studied, trained, and practiced under the Great Teacher from afar.

events.summary: Dragonspeaker Ishai invites Narset to study at Dragon's Eye Sanctuary.
events.quote: To study under the Great Teacher.

events.summary: At fifteen, Narset defeats Taigam in a practice match and is named Master by Ojutai, the youngest he has ever named.
events.quote: At fifteen, she was the youngest master Ojutai had ever named.

events.summary: Atop the summit, Narset feels trapped by the sense that there is nothing more to learn and is unable to thank Ojutai.
events.quote: And just like that she was trapped.

events.summary: After a year of worsening restlessness, Narset descends the mountain and finds an ancient forbidden archive beneath Dragon's Eye.
events.quote: It had to be an ancient archive, a place that she had only heard of in legend, a place that Ojutai had all but forbidden.

events.summary: The scrolls contradict Ojutai's teaching by speaking of khans and dragons before him.
events.quote: And from what the scrolls said, it seemed that there had been dragons before Ojutai.

events.summary: Taigam catches Narset and threatens to report her for blasphemy, but she blasts past him.
events.quote: Then let him!" Narset erupted with power, blasting past Taigam and ignoring his screams.

events.summary: Narset searches archives under Cori Mountain and Riverwheel and learns of Ugin and the dragon tempests.
events.quote: She learned of a Spirit Dragon, Ugin, who was the source of all magic on the plane, as well as the dragon tempests.

events.summary: In the looted archive beneath Dirgur, Narset reads the last scroll about the khans' summit and discovers Ojutai led the attack on them, which also reveals Sarkhan.
events.quote: One of those dragons had been Ojutai.

events.summary: Narset's spark ignites and she is pulled toward another world, but at the last moment she pulls herself back.
events.quote: And then she was pulled backward with such a force as she had never felt before and ripped away from Tarkir.

events.summary: Years later, by the river bend, Ojutai asks Narset what she has learned, and she tells him she has learned the truth.
events.quote: I have learned the truth," she whispered.

events.summary: Narset thanks Ojutai and lets go, walking away from Tarkir.
events.quote: Her words were carried away on the winds of Tarkir as she let go.

relations.note: Her teacher, who names her Master.

relations.quote: Ojutai's dragonspeaker is talking to me!

relations.note: Rival who reports her for blasphemy.
relations.quote: I have no choice but to report you for blasphemy.

relations.note: A student at Dragon's Eye Sanctuary.
relations.quote: He had been at the Sanctuary much longer than she.

relations.note: In the lost timeline, Narset fell at Zurgo's hands.
relations.quote: she fell at the hands of Zurgo Helmsmasher, the khan of the Mardu
